```plato

// A second-order jet of a parametric surface at Uv: position, both first
// partial derivatives, and the three second partials.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parametric_surface)
type SurfaceJet3D
    implements IValue
{
    Uv: UvCoordinate;
    Position: Point3D;
    DerivativeU: Vector3D;
    DerivativeV: Vector3D;
    DerivativeUU: Vector3D;
    DerivativeUV: Vector3D;
    DerivativeVV: Vector3D;
}
```
